about: The pilot's checklist notebook's own pages and places (modern-iaf/docs/training.md §11): the radio frequencies by base, the calls, the landing, weapons (each step's key record of data/keys.json) and emergency pages by jet family (f16: the Sufa and the Barak; f35i), the stowed board's place on the right thigh in each 3D cockpit's frame, and the gauge each start-up step watches. The start-up and taxi / take-off pages come from the missions' training data. Read by modern-iaf/flight/kneeboard.gd.

sources.pages.f16.weapons: the F-16 cockpit's switch places as the 3D cockpit draws them (ST STA on the AVIONIC POWER panel, MASTER ARM on the MISC panel); the keys are the sim's key table (data/keys.json); the steps are the shared weapons code's (docs/weapons.md)
